utility: U = GrossPnL - Cost; Cost = 0 (no cost owner)
oracle_semantics: at most one round-trip trade per horizon; Long/Short/Wait; Wait owns future option value
fills: next valid 5m bar open (entry and exit); no same-bar hindsight
fix_A: Q_W(t,h)=0 when disc[t+1]=1; whole horizon banned from crossing
fix_D: tie via numeric eps; n_best==1 -> unique else Tie; stable needs all 3 horizons SAME UNIQUE action
fix_E: label_available_time per H (reason HORIZON_END/DISCONTINUITY/DATA_END); not the optimal exit time
fix_F: raw price points retained + ATR5-normalized (units only, does not enter argmax/exit/DP)
fix_H: per-symbol raw 5m loaded once; samples reuse it
shared_compute: one load + one segment build + one QL/QS precompute + one backward flat DP; H=6/12/24 read from tables
